title: floats print as the shortest round-trip decimal text
purpose: Non-terminating binary values print with the fewest digits that read back to the same float.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 19.10.2026 (D-032): float text is Go strconv.FormatFloat(x, 'g', -1, 64) (oracle: go1.26.1, runtime values; digits cross-checked with Python repr).
